sources.title: Sonchus microcephalus Mejias
sources.clean: Sonchus microcephalus has the unusual chromosome number of 2n = 30. It has been explained by dysploid reduction from 2n = 32 of its closest relative, the allotetraploid S. oleraceus. Its basic number is therefore x = 15.
